calls.title: Alyssa Ransbury and Cary Rakin
calls.summary: The discussion centered on using the cloud version of GrowthBook for scalability and risk reduction, supporting clients managing 8,000 active feature flags and millions of requests. Key features include Fastly edge caching for unlimited query capacity, and Alyssa emphasized the need to avoid local deployment delays. The SDK integration was detailed, requiring configuration for API and user attributes, with exposure events logged into Snowflake for data analysis. Participants discussed experiment management, linking feature flags, and flexible targeting rules. A 6-week timeline was established for the POC, with immediate experiment setup following cloud confirmation and minimal SDK changes necessary for migration.
calls.keywords: feature flag, experiment, scalability, cloud vs internal, sticky bucketing, SDK configuration
